content:
Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd., situated in the Lantian Industrial Zone of Yongzhong Town, Longwan District, China, is a prominent and innovative chemical manufacturing enterprise dedicated to delivering high-quality chemical products to a diverse range of industries. With a strategic location in one of China’s vibrant industrial hubs, the company benefits from excellent infrastructure, robust supply chain networks, and access to skilled technical talent, positioning it as a competitive player in both domestic and international markets.

Since its establishment, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical has focused on the research, development, and production of a broad spectrum of chemical compounds, including specialty chemicals, industrial raw materials, and custom formulations designed to meet the unique needs of its clients. The company is committed to adopting advanced technologies and sustainable practices, ensuring that its processes not only maximize efficiency and product quality but also minimize environmental impact. This dedication to innovation and environmental stewardship reflects the company’s corporate social responsibility ethos and its vision for long-term growth.

Wenzhou Longchang Chemical’s experienced management team and skilled workforce work collaboratively to maintain stringent quality control standards, adhere to industry regulations, and deliver timely solutions that foster strong partnerships with downstream industries such as textiles, plastics, coatings, and pharmaceuticals. Through continuous investment in research and development, the company strives to expand its product portfolio and improve its technical capabilities, driving progress in the chemical sector while contributing to the economic development of the Longwan District.
